purpose: コップの左側製品写真を斜め上から見せ、飲み口と穴を明示。右側の使用動作を維持。

images.name: cup-body-pair-v2
images.prompt: Edit this two-panel teaching photograph. Preserve the RIGHT panel as closely as possible: same Japanese toddler, face, hands, cup, action, background, framing and light. Preserve the two equally sized side-by-side panels, white gutter, wide 2:1 layout. Change ONLY the LEFT product photograph's camera angle to an unmistakable HIGH THREE-QUARTER VIEW from about 45-55 degrees ABOVE the tabletop, looking down into or onto the top of the cup. The upper surface must be large and clearly visible. Keep the whole cup inside the left frame, sufficiently large, all handles visible if present. Same cup design and color as the right panel, pale wood table, no hands on the product. No words, labels, logos, arrows, diagrams or extra panels. This is a functional close-up to understand how the mouth contacts the cup. Do not merely raise the camera a tiny bit: the top must be clearly seen from above. LEFT: cream handleless open tumbler. Show the fully open broad circular rim as a large ellipse and clearly visible INNER WALL and empty interior, conveying no lid or straw. Right stays child trying to hold wide cream cup.
